name: Custom Shape 2-Layer Wooden Book Stand With Reading Counter
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    - Crafted from high-quality wood, ensuring durability and a warm decorative appearance.
    - The structure features a 2-layer wooden panel design, creating a dimensional decorative display.
    - Panel layers: made from 5 mm thick wood, providing a sturdy and stable structure.
    - Base: constructed from 5 mm thick wood, designed to hold the panels in place securely.
    - Number cards: made from 3 mm wooden pieces with smooth edges and clear printing.
    - Carefully laser-cut components ensure precise shapes, smooth edges, and easy assembly.

 

  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    - Overall Dimensions: 12 x 10 in ~ 30.48 x 25.4 cm.
    - Base Size: 12 x 10 in ~ 30.48 x 25.4 cm.
    - Minimum Number Card Size: 0.79 x 0.79 in ~ 2 x 2 cm.
    📌 Note: The product dimensions may vary slightly depending on the design, as sizes are not fixed.

 

  • Printing Technology:
    - Produced using advanced UV printing technology to deliver vibrant colors and crisp details.
    - Panel 1: supports 2-sided printing.
    - Panel 2: 1-sided printing for decorative elements.
    - Base and hanging bars: 2-sided printing for a finished appearance from multiple viewing angles.
    - Number cards: printed on both sides for clear and easy visibility.
    - The printing process ensures long-lasting color, high-definition artwork, and resistance to fading.

 

  • Functional & Usage:
    - Designed as a decorative wooden book stand with an integrated reading counter.
    - Includes number cards (0–9) that allow users to track reading progress, pages read, or daily goals.
    - The layered wooden design creates a 3D decorative effect, making it both functional and visually appealing.
    - Perfect for placement on desks, bookshelves, reading corners, libraries, or study spaces.
    - Ideal for book lovers, students, teachers, and reading enthusiasts.

 

  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    - A thoughtful gift for book lovers, teachers, students, and family members.
    - Perfect for birthdays, Christmas, back-to-school gifts, or reading-themed celebrations.
    - Ideal for anyone who enjoys reading, collecting books, or decorating their reading space.
    - Combines practical functionality with creative décor, making it a meaningful and unique keepsake.🎁

  • Processing Time: 1 – 3 working days on average after payment and all designs updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 6 – 9 working days on average (US)
  • Packaging: 1 x Custom Shape 2-Layer Wooden Book Stand With Reading Counter

guideLine:
Print Guidelines

Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
